posts.name: Laubrani
posts.cooked:
Juliane_Eriker:

I can see 29 days and 175 days old character flying Hulks and Orca

SP to sit in Hulk with 2 miners + mining boost low: 2140010.
1 Mill from recruitment. 12*2 dailies at 10K (240K + 225K = 465K), a little bit of AIR 450K. You can almost do it in 12 days without even using the training queue on it … And then we also just had event SP on top.

SP for Orca ore boost only, is less than 800k.

Yes they will need a lot more backing skills and to up to T2, but this will let them start mine.

Apart from that, even if it was impossible to sit in the ships (no skill injectors, actual train time too short etc) this would be some sort of server hack to make the characters, not bots.

I really wish people would learn what a bot is before opening their mouth on the subject.

1: The accusation has nothing to do with bots.

2: The accusations aren’t even remotely close to hard to meet, even if meeting them were somehow related to bots.

EDIT And the reason it is so annoying, is constant trolling on subjects, makes it impossible ot have a serious talk on the subject, for people that actually knows something about it. And impossible for people actually curious to learn, to find any serious information on the subject.

posts.name: John Rochard
posts.cooked:
Welcome to the forums,

If you suspect botting, you can always report the character. It is really up to CCP to apprehend the bots. I have no idea what software they use to do this, or if they sit down manually and pick through the server logs. Either way, it will take time to get results.

You seem to list no evidence of botting. I suspect botting at the schools where I see piles of wrecks. These wrecks just outside the school stations, are usually one character launching out just to be killed by another who is racking up the PvP score. Normally I would say there is a person at work here, but the timing seems too smooth to be nothing more than automation.

While I suspect this person of botting, I don’t think I can honestly say, they are wrecking my gameplay. There might be mining bots out there, unless I chat with the miner, I no way of knowing. Again, if you suspect a bot, simply report them through the proper channels and not here on the forums. Coming in here and yelling John Rochard is a dirty botter, won’t give CCP a chance to flex their security or study me at all. The botter will slip into the shadows emerge elsewhere.

Fly safe o7

Hi, in our system, we have followed “bot” fleet and they don’t react like any other players. If we follow those “bot” fleet they deploy miningdrones, fire up boost, even when they just entered into system, and that at the jumpgate. If they are followed to a mining belt, they fly to next belt. If we wait a couple of minutes and jump to belt where they are, they stop mining and fly to next belt.

We can follow those fleet in a hour or more, where they start from exampel belt V - 1 to VIII - 8 and then they start over from V - 1 to VIII - 8

After we saw that pattern, we could just wait at a belt we knew they would jump to and then they jumped right away without start mining.

That was going on for several weeks.

Becouse of that behavor, we are convinced that it’s bots.

Doing AIR kills. It will be rather exact. Explode, wait for session timer, dock, wait for session timer, reship, wait for session timer, undock, get locked, get shot, explode, wait for session timer, dock …

And yes the shooter is your alt or a friend, where you are doing the opposite for them after.

This is by no means a sign of a bot, as humans will just be sitting watching that 10 second wheel nonstop, eager to get through this extremely dull session. Can a bot be doing it, yes? But is there any signs its not human? No.
